entries.summary: EnemySystem: Enemy is an Area2D (res://scenes/enemy.tscn + scripts/enemy.gd). Exports speed=150, health=1, score_value=100. Signal died(position). Auto-adds to 'enemies' group. Moves downward, despawn below viewport. take_damage() -> die() emits died, calls GameManager.add_score(score_value), queues free. On body_entered with 'players' group, calls body.take_damage() then queues free. No shooting logic.

ExplosionSystem: Explosion is a Node2D (res://scenes/explosion.tscn + scripts/explosion.gd). Exports max_radius=60, duration=0.5, color=Color.ORANGE, line_width=4.0. Self-draws expanding arc via _draw(); auto queue_free() after duration. No signal. Must be spawned at enemy death position.

Collision layer/mask gaps: enemy.tscn Area2D and player.tscn CharacterBody2D have no explicit collision_layer or collision_mask set, so they rely on Godot defaults (layer/mask = 1). Player is not in 'players' group, nor does it implement take_damage(), which enemy.gd expects for player collision. Player bullets are NOT implemented anywhere in the project (no bullet scene, no bullet script, no shoot input).
Game 现在管理波次、震屏、击杀与连击状态。GameManager 新增 kill_count/combo 信号与 register_kill()，敌人死亡时 Game 调用 register_kill() 并触发 Camera2D offset Tween 震屏。HUD 已连接新信号显示 Kills 和 Combo。每 30 秒自动 next_wave，敌人速度与生成间隔随波次提升。
